name: eigen-form
description: Mathematical design library — parameterized eigenform rendering. v0.4: the engine no longer owns any background/reference color (opts.bg, setParam('bg', ...), and data-bg are gone — the host page owns the ground), and closes out three HIGH-severity engine bugs (double-init dedup, NaN-safe construction, resize self-heal), atop v0.3's configurable color band, v0.2's declared parameter schemas and generated control-surface panel (src/params, src/panel), v0.1's torus-knot engine seams, headless golden-op regression tests, and versioned figure specs.
author: Myrgic Labs

scripts.check: npm run test && npm run golden:check && npm run lab:check
